title: The Flag & the Coat of Arms - A zászló és a címer

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe the Hungarian flag's colours (piros, fehér, zöld) and their traditional symbolic meanings.
I can explain the heraldry of the coat of arms: the Árpád stripes (traditionally four rivers), the triple mound, and the apostolic double cross.
I can say where the Szent Korona (Holy Crown) is kept today.
I can say how many stripes the flag has and what the coat of arms consists of.
I can use -ból/-ből áll and heraldic verbs (szimbolizál, jelképez) to describe composite national symbols.
